components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary conversion or completion action on light and dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#0369a1; color:#fff; padding:10px 20px; border:0; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(3,105,161,.2); font:600 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#075985; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #069bd8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet alternative action for light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#fff; color:#0f172a; padding:10px 20px; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05); font:600 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f8fafc; border-color:#94a3b8; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #069bd8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Inverse Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action for a dark operational surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-inverse-outline { background:transparent; color:#fff; padding:10px 20px; border:1px solid #334155; border-radius:8px; font:600 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 150ms ease,background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-inverse-outline:hover { border-color:#64748b; background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); } .ds-btn-inverse-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #069bd8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Calm Card
components.description: Default light-surface container for related content and product options.
components.html:
CX PLATFORM

Composable customer operations

Keep related information clear, calm, and easy to scan.
components.css: .ds-card { width:260px; padding:24px; background:#fff; color:#012635; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,.05); font:400 14px/1.6 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:#cbd5e1; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -4px rgba(15,23,42,.08); } .ds-card h3 { margin:6px 0; font:700 18px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans',Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:#475569; } .ds-card-label { color:#069bd8 !important; font:600 11px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono',monospace !important; letter-spacing:.06em; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Form field for contact and product search surfaces.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:7px; width:260px; color:#012635; font:600 11px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-field input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; padding:10px 14px; background:#f8fafc; color:#0f172a; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:12px; font:400 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; outline:none; transition:background-color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#64748b; } .ds-field input:focus { background:#fff; border-color:#069bd8; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(6,155,216,.16); }

components.name: Workflow Phase Tab
components.description: Selectable phase control for dark operational walkthroughs.
components.css: .ds-workflow-tab { display:grid; gap:8px; min-width:150px; padding:12px; color:#fff; text-align:left; background:rgba(56,189,248,.1); border:1px solid #7dd3fc; border-radius:12px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-workflow-number { color:#bae6fd; font:700 12px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-workflow-tab strong { font-size:14px; letter-spacing:.02em; } .ds-workflow-tab small { overflow:hidden; color:#cbd5e1; font-size:11px; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-workflow-tab:hover { background:rgba(56,189,248,.17); } .ds-workflow-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7dd3fc; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: CXdynamIQ presents complex, AI-led customer-experience operations as assured and legible. The system pairs cool white work surfaces with deep navy and teal operational zones, then uses a clear sky-blue action color to direct attention. It should feel like a dependable control plane: technical enough to communicate capability, but never noisy or intimidating. The implementation favors generous whitespace, stable containers, low-contrast dividers, and intentional information density.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, high-trust enterprise SaaS with an operational edge.
Sky-blue actions against clean slate, white, and deep-teal surfaces.
Human-readable Jakarta headings, efficient Inter body copy, and monospace only for labels, metrics, and technical traces.
Rounded, softly elevated surfaces with borders doing most of the separation work.

rules.name: The Blue Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use the bright blue family to indicate action, selection, focus, or system signal—not as a large decorative field.

rules.name: The Night Operations Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces are for platform depth, telemetry, navigation, and high-context demonstrations. Routine content remains on calm light surfaces.

rules.name: The Human-First Type Rule
rules.body: Monospace communicates measurement or execution context; it never replaces reading typography or becomes a decorative brand voice.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Borders establish grouping; shadows appear only when a surface must sit above another surface or acknowledge interaction.

dos: Do place core content in the established max-w-7xl responsive container rhythm.
Do use Operational Blue for the primary decision on a surface and Signal Cyan for active, focused, or technical states.
Do keep cards light, bordered, and softly elevated; use dark panels only when they carry operational or platform context.
Do preserve a visible cyan focus outline and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do use JetBrains Mono only for labels, metadata, metrics, and code or workflow traces.
donts: Don't use emerald or teal as a primary button background; primary actions use the established blue treatment.
Don't substitute heavy gradients, hard shadows, or noisy decoration for hierarchy.
Don't turn every container into a card; use whitespace, grouping, and subtle dividers first.
Don't introduce new corner radii or ad-hoc accent colors when an established surface, blue, cyan, or slate treatment applies.
